page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i3g.26xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by dedicated Intel Xeon 8269CY processors running at 2.5 GHz. This instance provides 104 dedicated vCPUs and 384.0 GB of system memory, yielding approximately 3.69 GB of RAM per core. It operates on a KVM hypervisor.

A key feature of this instance is its bundled local storage, consisting of 5759 GB of SSD capacity. This high-capacity local storage is paired with a baseline network bandwidth of 32 Gbps, facilitating rapid data transfer and low-latency local I/O operations.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.i3g.26xlarge delivers high resource density by combining a large CPU core count with substantial local SSD storage on a single instance. This configuration is suitable for I/O-intensive workloads, large-scale databases, data warehousing, and general-purpose applications requiring high local storage throughput and significant parallel processing capabilities.
